Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary For the Petitioner : Mr. Mukesh Kumar,
Advocate For the State : Mr. R.R. Ravi Das, A.P.P.

------
Order No.02 Dated : 20.03.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioners- Tapas Banerjee is in custody since 22.12.2022 in connection with C.P. Case No.1278 of 2019 for the offence registered under Sections 498A, 323, 504 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of J.M. 1 st Class, Bokaro.

It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the petitioner is husband and has been arrested and remanded into custody in contravention with the guidelines of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Versus State of Bihar & Another; (2014) 8 SCC 273.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Versus State of Bihar & Another; (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
